column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 06 (M23006): Chiloveig & Ateraxis di lab Girard, Asteria menghubungi M16.
# Tetap Inggris: Girard Group, Orlog, Chiloveig, Ateraxis, Alexei Girard, Orphelune Girard,
# FABN Group, Paradise Project, Relics, Nirvana, Lunasia, Boojum, Graurizard, Asteria,
# M16, Beluga, AR-15, M4, M4A1, AR Team, Soppo, Robella, Vindicator's Mark, Paradeus,
# Griffin & Kryuger, Sangvis Ferri, Parapluie, Neural cloud, Doll, Frankfurt.
(The cold lights of the laboratory shone on the huge and dilapidated 'Girard Group' logo.)
column2: (Lampu dingin laboratorium menyorot logo 'Girard Group' yang besar dan sudah rusak.)

column1: (A few months ago, this place was still a thriving scene. But now, only a few withered plants and many long-dried petri dishes remain.)
column2: (Beberapa bulan lalu, tempat ini masih ramai berdenyut. Tapi sekarang hanya tersisa beberapa tanaman layu dan banyak cawan petri yang sudah lama mengering.)

column1: (Girard Group, once the largest industrial company within the Orlog Financial Conglomerate, completely collapsed due to an 'experimental accident', and its business and assets were entirely carved up by several other groups.)
column2: (Girard Group, yang dulu perusahaan industri terbesar di dalam Orlog Financial Conglomerate, ambruk total akibat sebuah 'kecelakaan eksperimen', dan seluruh bisnis serta asetnya dicabik-cabik beberapa grup lain.)

column1: (And at this moment, the culprit who caused everything was still standing leisurely in front of her old experimental bench, wearing the exact same sly smile as before.)
column2: (Dan saat ini, biang keladi dari semua itu masih berdiri santai di depan meja eksperimen lamanya, dengan senyum licik yang sama persis seperti dulu.)

column1: Oh my—how nostalgic! Look at this familiar console, this spotless lab coat, and these cute little flowers—
column2: Aduh—nostalgik sekali! Lihat konsol yang akrab ini, jas lab yang bersih tanpa noda ini, dan bunga-bunga kecil yang menggemaskan ini—

column1: Tch~ They're already dead.
column2: Cih~ Semuanya sudah mati.

column1: But it's okay, as long as they undergo "that kind" of surgery, they can definitely be successfully resurrected!
column2: Tapi tidak apa-apa, asal menjalani operasi "yang itu", mereka pasti bisa dibangkitkan kembali!

column1: Hehehe~ I really want to do that too! Cut open the epidermis of this little flower, soak it in the culture fluid, and then... this and that, that and this... and finally sew them all up!
column2: Hehehe~ Aku juga ingin sekali melakukannya! Belah epidermis bunga kecil ini, rendam di cairan kultur, lalu... begini dan begitu, begitu dan begini... dan terakhir jahit semuanya!

column1: This way—"poof poof poof" new flowers will bloom, right, little one?
column2: Dengan begitu—"pop pop pop" bunga-bunga baru akan mekar, kan, Adik Kecil?

column1: (Chiloveig jumped onto the test bench, exaggeratedly spread her arms, and asked the other person in the room.)
column2: (Chiloveig melompat ke atas meja uji, merentangkan tangan berlebihan, dan bertanya pada satu-satunya orang lain di ruangan itu.)

column1: Hey hey, say something~ It's boring to perform a one-man show!
column2: Hei hei, bilang sesuatu dong~ Membosankan main teater tunggal begini!

column1: ...You're too noisy.
column2: ...Kau berisik sekali.

column1: (Compared to Chiloveig, the young girl who stepped into the room next appeared very quiet. She walked around the experimental bench, leaving a trail of dust where her fingertips brushed past.)
column2: (Dibandingkan Chiloveig, gadis muda yang masuk ke ruangan berikutnya tampak sangat pendiam. Dia berjalan mengitari meja eksperimen, meninggalkan jejak debu di tempat ujung jarinya melintas.)

column1: I just wanted to create some harmless background noise~ Surrounded by white noise, it's more helpful for thinking, little Ateraxis~
column2: Aku cuma mau menciptakan derau latar yang tidak berbahaya~ Dikelilingi white noise itu lebih membantu berpikir, Ateraxis kecil~

column1: Not to mention this place is so interesting, it's hard for anyone not to get excited, right?
column2: Apalagi tempat ini menarik sekali, siapa pun pasti sulit menahan rasa penasaran, kan?

column1: I haven't seen any existence here that interests me.
column2: Aku belum melihat satu pun keberadaan di sini yang menarik minatku.

column1: (Ateraxis returned to the center of the room, standing there and looking up around.)
column2: (Ateraxis kembali ke tengah ruangan, berdiri di sana sambil mendongak memandang sekeliling.)

column1: (Immediately after, as if she noticed something, she looked at a certain large experimental equipment below the steps.)
column2: (Tak lama kemudian, seolah menyadari sesuatu, dia menatap satu peralatan eksperimen besar di bawah anak tangga.)

column1: (Ateraxis examined it with a curious gaze—not the object itself, but somewhere beneath it, a place that the gaze could not directly reach.)
column2: (Ateraxis mengamatinya dengan tatapan penasaran—bukan bendanya, melainkan suatu tempat di bawahnya, tempat yang tak bisa dijangkau pandangan secara langsung.)

column1: However... I felt it from the very beginning.
column2: Tapi... aku merasakannya sejak awal.

column1: Eh? What what?
column2: Eh? Apa apa?

column1: What did you feel? I'm very familiar with this place, if you want to hear me—
column2: Apa yang kamu rasakan? Aku sangat mengenal tempat ini, kalau kamu mau dengar—

column1: There seems to be some kind of "special" smell here...
column2: Sepertinya ada semacam bau "khusus" di sini...

column1: And this scent... is far more interesting than everything here combined.
column2: Dan aroma ini... jauh lebih menarik daripada semua yang ada di sini digabung.

column1: (Ateraxis ignored Chiloveig's nonsense and instead stared intently at the spot she was interested in... It looked as though a container had once been placed there, but now it was completely empty, with only a defunct machine standing quietly in its place.)
column2: (Ateraxis mengabaikan omong kosong Chiloveig dan justru menatap lekat titik yang menarik minatnya... Tampaknya dulu ada wadah yang diletakkan di sana, tapi sekarang kosong melompong, hanya sebuah mesin mati yang berdiri diam menggantikannya.)

column1: (And right beneath it was an invisible space just large enough to fit about one person—which was exactly where Ateraxis's gaze lingered.)
column2: (Dan tepat di bawahnya ada ruang tak terlihat yang persis cukup untuk satu orang—dan di situlah pandangan Ateraxis berhenti.)

column1: (She slowly approached the area with great interest, her expression rarely softening slightly.)
column2: (Dia mendekati area itu perlahan dengan penuh minat, ekspresinya yang jarang melunak sedikit mengendur.)

column1: Could it be...
column2: Jangan-jangan...

column1: Ah—you mean this!
column2: Ah—maksudmu ini!

column1: (Just as Ateraxis was about to touch the machine, Chiloveig suddenly jumped in front of her.)
column2: (Tepat saat Ateraxis hendak menyentuh mesin itu, Chiloveig tiba-tiba melompat ke hadapannya.)

column1: That's right, it must be it... the great invention that gathers my life's blood, a miracle comparable to the Creator!
column2: Betul sekali, pasti itu... penemuan agung yang menghimpun darah kehidupanku, keajaiban yang setara dengan Sang Pencipta!

column1: But due to some accidents, its main body was accidentally moved to another place... right here!
column2: Tapi karena beberapa kecelakaan, badan utamanya tak sengaja dipindahkan ke tempat lain... tepat di sini!

column1: (Chiloveig took Ateraxis's hand like an ordinary girl shopping, half-pushing and half-pulling her to another corner of the laboratory.)
column2: (Chiloveig menggandeng tangan Ateraxis seperti gadis biasa yang sedang belanja, setengah mendorong setengah menarik ke sudut lain laboratorium.)

column1: Ta-da—now placed in front of you is it—
column2: Ta-da—yang kini terpampang di hadapanmu adalah—

column1: The equipment to start the "Relics" experiment and open "Nirvana"—
column2: Perangkat untuk memulai eksperimen "Relics" dan membuka "Nirvana"—

column1: The most core experimental equipment of the "Paradise Project"!
column2: Peralatan eksperimen paling inti dari "Paradise Project"!

column1: Yes, this must be what you are interested in, right?
column2: Ya, ini pasti yang kamu minati, kan?

column1: After all, how could there be any "thing" in this laboratory more interesting than it?
column2: Lagi pula, mana ada "benda" di laboratorium ini yang lebih menarik dari itu?

column1: (Chiloveig's pupils were bright, blinking a pair of eyes looking at Ateraxis.)
column2: (Pupil Chiloveig berbinar, matanya berkedip menatap Ateraxis.)

column1: ...I suppose so.
column2: ...Mungkin begitu.

column1: (The expression of obviously being disturbed on Ateraxis's face revealed a slight interest when she heard the word "Nirvana".)
column2: (Wajah Ateraxis yang jelas-jelas terganggu memperlihatkan sedikit ketertarikan saat mendengar kata "Nirvana".)

column1: (She broke free from Chiloveig and walked towards the shattered sphere parked in the corner.)
column2: (Dia melepaskan diri dari Chiloveig dan berjalan menuju bola pecah yang teronggok di sudut.)

column1: You mean, you used it to... activate the relics.
column2: Maksudmu, kamu memakainya untuk... mengaktifkan relics itu.

column1: That's right, that's right~ It's this!
column2: Betul, betul~ Ini dia!

column1: Although it doesn't look very eye-catching, it did indeed capture a precious little flower specimen inside~
column2: Meski tampangnya tidak mencolok, benda ini benar-benar menangkap satu spesimen bunga kecil yang berharga di dalamnya~

column1: If what you say is the truth, then the current you shouldn't be like this.
column2: Kalau ucapanmu benar, maka dirimu yang sekarang tidak seharusnya seperti ini.

column1: Is this something that "happened", or something that "failed to happen"? I am very curious about this.
column2: Apakah ini sesuatu yang "terjadi", atau sesuatu yang "gagal terjadi"? Aku sangat penasaran soal itu.

column1: This is the reason I was willing to come here with you today... so, I hope you can satisfy my curiosity.
column2: Itulah alasan aku mau ikut denganmu ke sini hari ini... jadi, kuharap kamu bisa memuaskan rasa penasaranku.

column1: Of course, of course. When I was your age, my thirst for knowledge was just as strong as yours! Every day I was thirsty for knowledge facing equipment and books, staying up until the early hours of the morning every day before going to sleep, so my dark circles became super heavy!
column2: Tentu, tentu. Waktu seusiamu, hausku akan ilmu sama besarnya denganmu! Tiap hari aku dahaga ilmu di depan peralatan dan buku, begadang sampai dini hari sebelum tidur, sampai kantung mataku tebal sekali!

column1: So little Ateraxis, you have to sleep well. Only when you've slept enough will you have the energy to stay up late!
column2: Jadi Ateraxis kecil, kamu harus tidur yang cukup. Cuma kalau tidurmu cukup kamu punya tenaga untuk begadang!

column1: At that time, if I felt tired, I would not hesitate to slack off... Little Ateraxis, you should understand, right? Relaxing now is to let the brain completely empty out; and letting the brain completely empty out is to free up more brain capacity to hold the anxiety later! Only by completely loosening the mainspring can you experience the "thrill" of winding it to the edge of breaking!
column2: Waktu itu, kalau merasa capek aku tidak ragu bermalas-malasan... Ateraxis kecil pasti paham, kan? Santai sekarang itu untuk mengosongkan otak sepenuhnya; dan mengosongkan otak sepenuhnya itu untuk menyisakan kapasitas lebih banyak menampung kecemasan nanti! Cuma dengan mengendurkan pegas sepenuhnya kamu bisa merasakan "sensasi" memutarnya sampai nyaris patah!

column1: Oh right, back then, every time I finished an experiment, I would clean the countertop until it was spotless, not even leaving a single fingerprint. This wasn't mysophobia, it was for a sense of ritual! Think about it, if we don't tidy up the laboratory neatly, the next time we blow up the laboratory... ah no, the next time we make a big commotion, we can reflect the spectacular destructiveness through a sharp contrast. Only in absolute order does chaos appear exceptionally charming! So, in order to make a bigger mess next time, please be sure to clean it up even cleaner now! How about it, isn't the dialectical relationship in this very philosophical?
column2: Oh iya, dulu tiap selesai eksperimen aku selalu membersihkan meja sampai kinclong, tidak menyisakan satu sidik jari pun. Ini bukan fobia kotor, ini demi rasa ritual! Coba pikir, kalau laboratoriumnya tidak dirapikan, lain kali saat kita meledakkan laboratorium... ah bukan, lain kali saat kita bikin heboh besar, kita bisa menonjolkan kehancuran yang spektakuler lewat kontras yang tajam. Cuma di dalam ketertiban mutlak kekacauan tampak begitu memikat! Jadi, supaya lain kali bisa bikin berantakan lebih parah, tolong bersihkan sekarang sampai lebih bersih lagi! Bagaimana, bukankah hubungan dialektis di sini sangat filosofis?

column1: Ah, ah, showing this expression again... really~
column2: Ah, ah, pasang ekspresi itu lagi... aduh~

column1: Little one, you must be patient when learning knowledge, you can't be impatient with the teacher.
column2: Adik Kecil, belajar ilmu itu harus sabar, tidak boleh tidak sabaran pada guru.

column1: ............I haven't gotten the answer I want yet.
column2: ............Aku belum mendapat jawaban yang kuinginkan.

column1: Answer... right, answer. We did just talk about this.
column2: Jawaban... oh iya, jawaban. Kita memang baru saja membahas ini.

column1: Then... which 'answer' do you want to hear?
column2: Kalau begitu... 'jawaban' yang mana yang ingin kamu dengar?

column1: Was Alexei Girard used by a despicable evil scientist, causing the great project of plant power generation to fall short of success?
column2: Apakah Alexei Girard dimanfaatkan seorang ilmuwan jahat yang keji, sehingga proyek agung pembangkit listrik tumbuhan itu gagal di ujung jalan?

column1: Or was the entire Girard Group wiped out in advance, leaving the FABN Group as the sole dominant force and the new leader of the Paradise Project?
column2: Atau seluruh Girard Group dilenyapkan lebih dulu, menyisakan FABN Group sebagai penguasa tunggal dan pemimpin baru Paradise Project?

column1: Or perhaps...
column2: Atau mungkin...

column1: A certain genius girl favored by the gods, who only wanted to benefit humanity, became the biggest culprit causing the entire world to overturn?
column2: Seorang gadis jenius yang disayang para dewa, yang cuma ingin membawa manfaat bagi umat manusia, malah jadi biang keladi terbesar yang menjungkirbalikkan seluruh dunia?

column1: ...Orphelune Girard already died in Frankfurt many years ago.
column2: ...Orphelune Girard sudah mati di Frankfurt bertahun-tahun lalu.

column1: At least that's the answer known to the world.
column2: Setidaknya itulah jawaban yang diketahui dunia.

column1: I understand that your current situation is very difficult. "That person" drove you out of the sanctuary, and the power you relied on in the past doesn't seem to intend to continue protecting you.
column2: Aku paham situasimu sekarang sangat sulit. "Orang itu" mengusirmu dari tempat perlindungan, dan kekuatan yang dulu kamu andalkan sepertinya tidak berniat terus melindungimu.

column1: So... you are eager to show me your value.
column2: Jadi... kamu ingin sekali menunjukkan nilaimu padaku.

column1: But what I want to hear is the answer... not delusions.
column2: Tapi yang ingin kudengar adalah jawaban... bukan delusi.

column1: Delusions...?
column2: Delusi...?

column1: Hehe~ Do you think everything I just said was a delusion?
column2: Hehe~ Kamu pikir semua yang barusan kukatakan itu delusi?

column1: I'll tell you a secret—little Ateraxis, I'm only telling you, so make sure not to spread it around~
column2: Kuberitahu satu rahasia—Ateraxis kecil, cuma padamu kuberitahu, jadi jangan sebarkan ya~

column1: (Chiloveig leaned into Ateraxis's ear and whispered slowly.)
column2: (Chiloveig mendekat ke telinga Ateraxis dan berbisik pelan.)

column1: Everything I just said really happened.
column2: Semua yang barusan kukatakan benar-benar terjadi.

column1: Prove it to me.
column2: Buktikan padaku.

column1: Unfortunately, I have no way of proving it right now...
column2: Sayangnya, aku tidak punya cara untuk membuktikannya sekarang...

column1: But as long as you open the relics and witness the existence of 'Nirvana', you'll understand that everything I said is true~
column2: Tapi asal kamu membuka relics itu dan menyaksikan keberadaan 'Nirvana', kamu akan paham semua ucapanku benar~

column1: Are you saying that Nirvana allows contradictory facts to coexist?
column2: Maksudmu Nirvana membuat fakta-fakta yang bertentangan bisa berdampingan?

column1: You see, that is the greatness of Nirvana!
column2: Nah, itulah kehebatan Nirvana!

column1: Not only can it make contradictory facts exist at the same time, but it can also make the past and the future happen together... And, it can even allow the soul to cross the obstacles of the flesh, achieving true 'omniscience' and 'immortality'!
column2: Bukan cuma membuat fakta yang bertentangan ada bersamaan, tapi juga membuat masa lalu dan masa depan terjadi berbarengan... Dan bahkan bisa membuat jiwa melampaui penghalang daging, mencapai 'kemahatahuan' dan 'keabadian' yang sejati!

column1: (After Chiloveig finished speaking, she paused for a moment as if expecting the other party to answer.)
column2: (Setelah selesai bicara, Chiloveig berhenti sejenak seolah menanti jawaban lawan bicaranya.)

column1: (However, Ateraxis seemed somewhat uninterested in this speech, and just responded faintly.)
column2: (Namun Ateraxis tampak kurang tertarik dengan ucapan itu, dan hanya menanggapi seadanya.)

column1: Unfortunately, there is no way to verify your point of view.
column2: Sayangnya, tidak ada cara untuk memverifikasi pandanganmu.

column1: Little Ateraxis~ don't always complain that I'm long-winded. Some things just need to be talked about more to be explained clearly. Especially regarding the subject of Nirvana—it's exactly thanks to it that so much information can explode in my brain at the same time!
column2: Ateraxis kecil~ jangan selalu mengeluh aku bertele-tele. Ada hal-hal yang memang harus banyak dibicarakan agar jelas. Apalagi soal Nirvana—justru berkat itulah begitu banyak informasi bisa meledak sekaligus di otakku!

column1: You just said that the information you obtained contradicts my narrative, but ah, this is another proof that Nirvana was once opened~
column2: Kamu bilang informasi yang kamu dapat bertentangan dengan ceritaku, tapi ah, itu justru bukti lain bahwa Nirvana pernah dibuka~

column1: In this smart head of mine that has been pierced by bullets several times and dissected several times, I remember very clearly—
column2: Di kepala pintarku yang sudah beberapa kali ditembus peluru dan beberapa kali dibedah ini, aku ingat dengan sangat jelas—

column1: (Chiloveig narrowed her eyes slightly, and her tone suddenly deepened.)
column2: (Chiloveig sedikit menyipitkan mata, dan nadanya mendadak menurun.)

column1: Last time, it was right here that I activated the relics.
column2: Terakhir kali, tepat di sinilah aku mengaktifkan relics itu.

column1: (Ateraxis moved her gaze away from the shattered sphere and seriously examined this room for the first time.)
column2: (Ateraxis mengalihkan pandangan dari bola pecah itu dan untuk pertama kalinya mengamati ruangan ini dengan serius.)

column1: (That great purge had long destroyed most of the things here, but the grand scale of the laboratory could still be seen from the entire wall of withered specimens and several abandoned large instruments.)
column2: (Penyisiran besar itu sudah lama memusnahkan sebagian besar isi ruangan, tapi skala megah laboratorium ini masih terlihat dari satu dinding penuh spesimen kering dan beberapa instrumen besar yang ditinggalkan.)

column1: (Ateraxis paced aimlessly through the massive testing grounds, flipping through the surviving experiment logs.)
column2: (Ateraxis melangkah tanpa arah di area uji yang luas itu, membolak-balik catatan eksperimen yang selamat.)

column1: (But clearly, she couldn't find any useful information that could corroborate what Chiloveig had said.)
column2: (Tapi jelas, dia tidak menemukan informasi berguna yang bisa menguatkan ucapan Chiloveig.)

column1: (But this didn't disappoint her—on the contrary, it piqued her interest even more.)
column2: (Tapi itu tidak mengecewakannya—justru sebaliknya, makin memancing minatnya.)

column1: Then you must have seen that person in 'Nirvana'.
column2: Kalau begitu kamu pasti pernah melihat orang itu di 'Nirvana'.

column1: Hm? Who?
column2: Hm? Siapa?

column1: Oh—you mean—
column2: Oh—maksudmu—

column1: Ever since I heard about her existence from Mother, I've always been very curious about 'her'.
column2: Sejak mendengar tentang keberadaannya dari Ibu, aku selalu sangat penasaran pada 'dia'.

column1: Unfortunately, Mother doesn't intend to let the current me meet her...
column2: Sayangnya, Ibu tidak berniat membiarkan diriku yang sekarang menemuinya...

column1: Although her purpose in creating me was to open the relics and reach the place called Nirvana—Mother wanted to make ample preparations before allowing me to enter.
column2: Meski tujuannya menciptakanku adalah membuka relics dan mencapai tempat bernama Nirvana—Ibu ingin persiapannya matang dulu sebelum mengizinkanku masuk.

column1: Oh my, what reason does an exiled student like me have to judge the teacher?
column2: Aduh, murid buangan sepertiku punya alasan apa untuk menilai gurunya?

column1: I can only say, she really treasures you, little Ateraxis. Is there really no melodramatic, touching relationship between you two? Like the deep affection between a mother and daughter?
column2: Aku cuma bisa bilang, dia benar-benar menyayangimu, Ateraxis kecil. Apa sungguh tidak ada hubungan mengharukan yang dramatis di antara kalian? Semacam kasih mendalam antara ibu dan anak?

column1: That kind of thing has no value to us.
column2: Hal semacam itu tidak ada nilainya bagi kami.

column1: Mother can teach me important things, and I can fulfill her wishes. That's enough.
column2: Ibu bisa mengajariku hal-hal penting, dan aku bisa mewujudkan keinginannya. Itu sudah cukup.

column1: However, as I grew, I developed a wish of my own, and it became an even higher priority than Mother's—and she clearly knew, yet still acquiesced to my acting freely.
column2: Tapi seiring aku tumbuh, muncul keinginanku sendiri, dan itu jadi lebih diutamakan daripada keinginan Ibu—dan dia jelas tahu, tapi tetap membiarkanku bertindak bebas.

column1: Is this what they call a rebellious phase?
column2: Apa ini yang disebut masa memberontak?

column1: What do you want to do, little Ateraxis? Your power isn't restrained like a Doll's, so most things in this world shouldn't be too hard for you, right? It makes me so jealous I could stick pins in a voodoo doll of you—just kidding, I'm totally on your side, you know.
column2: Apa yang mau kamu lakukan, Ateraxis kecil? Kekuatanmu tidak dikekang seperti Doll, jadi sebagian besar hal di dunia ini seharusnya tidak sulit bagimu, kan? Aku iri sampai ingin menusuk-nusuk boneka voodoo bergambar kamu—bercanda, aku sepenuhnya di pihakmu kok.

column1: Then, I want to know about 'Lunasia'.
column2: Kalau begitu, aku ingin tahu tentang 'Lunasia'.

column1: Of course, of course—
column2: Tentu, tentu saja—

column1: Of course I've seen the lady you mentioned~
column2: Tentu saja aku pernah melihat nona yang kamu maksud~

column1: I have to say, she is a quite interesting and understanding person~ Not only did she forgive my unauthorized intrusion, but she also generously gifted me many treasures I've dreamed of~
column2: Harus kuakui, dia orang yang cukup menarik dan pengertian~ Bukan cuma memaafkan penyusupanku tanpa izin, dia juga dengan murah hati menghadiahiku banyak harta yang kuimpikan~

column1: Even when I left, she personally saw me out the 'door'—
column2: Bahkan saat aku pergi, dia sendiri yang mengantarku sampai 'pintu'—

column1: My my, what a nostalgic encounter!
column2: Aduh, pertemuan yang nostalgik sekali!

column1: A very interesting lie, but there is a bit of truth in it.
column2: Kebohongan yang menarik, tapi ada sedikit kebenaran di dalamnya.

column1: Lie? No, no, this is all true!
column2: Bohong? Tidak, tidak, ini semua benar!

column1: It's fine, lying is your nature anyway.
column2: Tidak apa-apa, berbohong memang sudah sifatmu.

column1: As long as you can let me meet 'her', I can tolerate your exaggeration and scheming.
column2: Asal kamu bisa mempertemukanku dengan 'dia', aku bisa menoleransi lebay dan akal bulusmu.

column1: (An elusive smile slipped across Chiloveig's lips.)
column2: (Senyum yang sulit ditebak tersungging di bibir Chiloveig.)

column1: My my~ Of course I can...
column2: Aduh~ Tentu saja bisa...

column1: But if we do that, the professor will be angry, right? Little Ateraxis, are you okay with that?
column2: Tapi kalau kita begitu, Profesor akan marah, kan? Ateraxis kecil, kamu tidak apa-apa dengan itu?

column1: I defied Mother's expectations and refused to devour my sisters' flesh and blood, which means her design for me has deviated.
column2: Aku melawan harapan Ibu dan menolak melahap darah daging saudari-saudariku, artinya rancangannya untukku sudah menyimpang.

column1: To Mother, I have stepped into a realm even she is unfamiliar with, so she said everything is up to me to decide.
column2: Bagi Ibu, aku sudah melangkah ke wilayah yang bahkan asing baginya, jadi dia bilang semuanya terserah aku yang memutuskan.

column1: Since that's the case, I choose to go see Lunasia only as myself.
column2: Kalau memang begitu, aku memilih menemui Lunasia semata sebagai diriku sendiri.

column1: If I can still fulfill Mother's wish later, I will definitely go all out.
column2: Kalau nanti aku masih bisa mewujudkan keinginan Ibu, aku pasti akan berusaha sekuat tenaga.

column1: Ah... what touching growth... Little Ateraxis really likes Mother.
column2: Ah... pertumbuhan yang mengharukan... Ateraxis kecil benar-benar sayang Ibu.

column1: (Chiloveig raised her sleeve, pretending to wipe away non-existent tears.)
column2: (Chiloveig mengangkat lengan bajunya, pura-pura menyeka air mata yang tidak ada.)

column1: If we can really open Nirvana again, I believe Teacher will definitely understand everything you've done, little Ateraxis!
column2: Kalau kita benar-benar bisa membuka Nirvana lagi, aku yakin Guru pasti akan memahami semua yang kamu lakukan, Ateraxis kecil!

column1: Since you've made up your mind, little Ateraxis, let's act quickly~
column2: Karena tekadmu sudah bulat, Ateraxis kecil, ayo cepat bergerak~

column1: Act?
column2: Bergerak?

column1: Yeah~ To activate the relics, we still have a series of basic tasks to do.
column2: Iya~ Untuk mengaktifkan relics itu, masih ada serangkaian pekerjaan dasar yang harus kita lakukan.

column1: But without a doubt, the fastest way to open Nirvana and see "her" is—
column2: Tapi tak diragukan lagi, cara tercepat membuka Nirvana dan bertemu "dia" adalah—

column1: Find that "Commander".
column2: Temukan "Komandan" itu.

column1: (Chiloveig and Ateraxis left together.)
column2: (Chiloveig dan Ateraxis pergi bersama.)

column1: (At the same time, from beneath the hollow of the experimental apparatus where Ateraxis had just stood, a figure crawled out.)
column2: (Di saat bersamaan, dari rongga di bawah peralatan eksperimen tempat Ateraxis tadi berdiri, sesosok bayangan merangkak keluar.)

column1: ...That was close.
column2: ...Nyaris saja.

column1: If I get discovered here, things will get troublesome...
column2: Kalau aku ketahuan di sini, urusannya jadi repot...

column1: But her speculation was right, this place indeed... once activated the "Relics".
column2: Tapi dugaannya benar, tempat ini memang... pernah mengaktifkan "Relics".

column1: Find that 'Commander'...
column2: Temukan 'Komandan' itu...

column1: It can only be... our Commander.
column2: Itu pasti... Komandan kita.

column1: Now I have to contact that annoying guy...
column2: Sekarang aku harus menghubungi orang menyebalkan itu...

column1: (Asteria didn't care about the dust on her body, frowned tightly and took out her communicator.)
column2: (Asteria tak peduli pada debu di tubuhnya, mengerutkan kening dalam-dalam dan mengeluarkan komunikatornya.)

column1: (Soon, a response quickly came from that contact signal that hadn't been connected for a long time.)
column2: (Tak lama, respons cepat datang dari sinyal kontak yang sudah lama tidak tersambung itu.)

column1: 15, it's really been a long time.
column2: 15, sudah lama sekali ya.

column1: Finally figured it out and willing to have a drink with me?
column2: Akhirnya sadar juga dan mau minum bareng aku?

column1: ...No time for this nonsense, M16.
column2: ...Tidak ada waktu untuk omong kosong ini, M16.

column1: I investigated a lot of information following the route you mentioned.
column2: Aku menyelidiki banyak informasi mengikuti jalur yang kausebutkan.

column1: Including that 'Boojum Doll'... and the 'source' of the giant dragon called Graurizard.
column2: Termasuk 'Boojum Doll' itu... dan 'sumber' naga raksasa bernama Graurizard.

column1: Oh? Looks like you gained quite a lot.
column2: Oh? Sepertinya kau dapat banyak.

column1: But now there are more important things we need to do.
column2: Tapi sekarang ada hal yang lebih penting yang harus kita lakukan.

column1: That woman you mentioned has already set her sights on the Commander.
column2: Perempuan yang kamu sebut itu sudah mengincar Komandan.

column1: And the intelligence she holds is probably more than we expected.
column2: Dan informasi yang dia pegang mungkin lebih banyak dari perkiraan kita.

column1: That Boojum - who knows if it's even a Doll - is by her side. You should understand the strength of something like that, right?
column2: Boojum itu—entah dia Doll atau bukan—ada di sisinya. Kau paham kekuatan makhluk semacam itu, kan?

column1: I heard that even if you gathered all the Dolls in Griffin & Kryuger, they might not be able to cut a single hair on her head.
column2: Kudengar sekalipun kau mengumpulkan semua Doll di Griffin & Kryuger, mereka mungkin tidak bisa memotong sehelai pun rambutnya.

column1: Oh? Is that so? I thought you'd become a bit more confident after obtaining 'that thing'.
column2: Oh? Begitu? Kukira kau jadi sedikit lebih percaya diri setelah mendapat 'benda itu'.

column1: ...Stop bringing that up.
column2: ...Berhenti membahas itu.

column1: And even that thing can't solve all problems.
column2: Dan benda itu pun tidak bisa menyelesaikan semua masalah.

column1: You should be very clear about this kind of thing.
column2: Kau seharusnya sangat paham soal ini.

column1: Aren't you going to use it against them? That's...
column2: Kau tidak akan memakainya melawan mereka? Padahal...

column1: At least not yet.
column2: Setidaknya belum sekarang.

column1: When the time comes, I'll activate it.
column2: Kalau waktunya tiba, aku akan mengaktifkannya.

column1: Hehe, I guess you'll be using it very soon.
column2: Hehe, kurasa kau akan memakainya sebentar lagi.

column1: (Asteria ignored Beluga's probing.)
column2: (Asteria mengabaikan pancingan Beluga.)

column1: So, although the investigation is not completely over yet, we must contact the Commander as soon as possible.
column2: Jadi, meski penyelidikannya belum benar-benar selesai, kita harus menghubungi Komandan secepatnya.

column1: I think in the past ten years, there shouldn't be any time when he needs us more than now.
column2: Kurasa dalam sepuluh tahun terakhir, tidak ada saat dia lebih membutuhkan kita daripada sekarang.

column1: Hehe... that's true.
column2: Hehe... benar juga.

column1: It seems I need to prepare well for this reunion.
column2: Sepertinya aku harus bersiap baik-baik untuk reuni ini.

column1: You're looking forward to it too, right, 15?
column2: Kau juga menantikannya, kan, 15?

column1: Whether I'm looking forward to it or not, it has absolutely nothing to do with you.
column2: Aku menantikannya atau tidak, itu sama sekali bukan urusanmu.

column1: Do you mean that the only thing you're looking forward to is meeting the Commander?
column2: Maksudmu yang kaunantikan cuma bertemu Komandan?

column1: ...I didn't say that.
column2: ...Aku tidak bilang begitu.

column1: Haha... It's all the same.
column2: Haha... Sama saja.

column1: As long as the Commander is here, we're destined to meet again, aren't we?
column2: Selama Komandan ada, kita ditakdirkan bertemu lagi, kan?

column1: Hmm? Hey, don't say sentimental things to me at a time like this.
column2: Hmm? Hei, jangan bicara melankolis padaku di saat seperti ini.

column1: I'll cry.
column2: Nanti aku menangis.

column1: Ew, gross.
column2: Ih, menjijikkan.

column1: (Asteria seemed to have habitually ignored Beluga's inappropriate joke.)
column2: (Asteria tampaknya sudah terbiasa mengabaikan candaan Beluga yang tidak pada tempatnya.)

column1: You know I can't be like you, calmly accepting the fact that M4 has left.
column2: Kau tahu aku tidak bisa sepertimu, menerima dengan tenang kenyataan bahwa M4 sudah pergi.

column1: As long as there's a chance, I will definitely pull her back from that hellhole.
column2: Selama masih ada peluang, aku pasti akan menariknya kembali dari lubang neraka itu.

column1: But since I can't change the current situation right now, I can only do my best to fulfill her request.
column2: Tapi karena aku belum bisa mengubah keadaan sekarang, aku cuma bisa berusaha sebaik mungkin memenuhi permintaannya.

column1: So for the past ten years, I've been accomplishing certain things... trying my best to nip the possibility of opening Nirvana in the bud.
column2: Jadi selama sepuluh tahun ini, aku terus menuntaskan beberapa hal... berusaha sekuat tenaga mematikan kemungkinan Nirvana dibuka sejak dari akarnya.

column1: And regarding destroying Paradeus...
column2: Dan soal menghancurkan Paradeus...

column1: But everything we've done means...
column2: Tapi semua yang kita lakukan berarti...

column1: We are, bit by bit, personally strangling the possibility of seeing M4 again.
column2: Kita, sedikit demi sedikit, dengan tangan sendiri mencekik kemungkinan bertemu M4 lagi.

column1: Is such a request... too unfair, and too cruel?
column2: Apakah permintaan seperti itu... terlalu tidak adil, dan terlalu kejam?

column1: Ah, so you were caring about this matter.
column2: Ah, ternyata itu yang kaupikirkan.

column1: If you said you hadn't thought about these things at all, I wouldn't be surprised in the slightest.
column2: Kalau kau bilang sama sekali tidak memikirkan hal-hal ini, aku juga tidak akan kaget sedikit pun.

column1: I have thought about it.
column2: Aku sudah memikirkannya.

column1: AR-15, I am also a part of M4, just like you.
column2: AR-15, aku juga bagian dari M4, sama sepertimu.

column1: Although it's troublesome for Dolls to have such a setting... but when it comes to missing her, my feelings are the same as yours.
column2: Meski merepotkan bagi Doll punya pengaturan seperti itu... tapi soal merindukannya, perasaanku sama denganmu.

column1: Sometimes, I even ponder... what is the true death of a Doll.
column2: Kadang aku sampai merenung... apa sebenarnya kematian sejati bagi Doll.

column1: Backups disappear, unable to be restored, Neural cloud data completely disappears from this world...
column2: Cadangan lenyap, tidak bisa dipulihkan, data Neural cloud hilang sepenuhnya dari dunia ini...

column1: For special Dolls like us, if we completely die... can we return to that place and meet her?
column2: Bagi Doll istimewa seperti kita, kalau kita benar-benar mati... bisakah kita kembali ke tempat itu dan bertemu dia?

column1: To think you would ponder such things... it's really surprising.
column2: Tak kusangka kamu memikirkan hal seperti itu... sungguh mengejutkan.

column1: Haha, sometimes my thoughts are more delicate than you imagine.
column2: Haha, kadang pikiranku lebih halus daripada yang kamu bayangkan.

column1: But I keep feeling that it might be a bit too early to consider this right now?
column2: Tapi aku terus merasa memikirkan ini sekarang mungkin sedikit terlalu dini?

column1: After all, next, we must continue to protect the world where she and the Commander are.
column2: Lagi pula, selanjutnya kita harus terus melindungi dunia tempat dia dan Komandan berada.

column1: So these thoughts quickly went with the wind, haha.
column2: Jadi pikiran-pikiran itu cepat terbawa angin, haha.

column1: Heh... you're really open-minded.
column2: Heh... kamu benar-benar berpikiran terbuka.

column1: Is the side effect of the Parapluie virus making people become idiots who can only run single-threaded like Sangvis Ferri?
column2: Apa efek samping virus Parapluie itu membuat orang jadi bodoh yang cuma bisa jalan satu jalur seperti Sangvis Ferri?

column1: Haha, want to experience it? That way you won't always overthink things like you do.
column2: Haha, mau coba? Biar kau tidak selalu terlalu banyak berpikir seperti sekarang.

column1: Forget it, not everyone can be an idiot with peace of mind like you.
column2: Sudahlah, tidak semua orang bisa jadi orang bodoh yang tenang sepertimu.

column1: But if what you say is true... I think, one day, we will truly be together with her.
column2: Tapi kalau ucapanmu benar... kurasa, suatu hari nanti, kita benar-benar akan bersama dia lagi.

column1: When that time comes...
column2: Kalau saatnya tiba...

column1: (After a moment of silence, Asteria hung up the communication.)
column2: (Setelah hening sejenak, Asteria menutup komunikasinya.)

column1: (For a long time, she had avoided imagining the scene of meeting everyone again... because no matter what, it would remind her of someone she might never be able to see again.)
column2: (Sudah lama dia menghindari membayangkan adegan bertemu semua orang lagi... karena bagaimanapun, itu akan mengingatkannya pada seseorang yang mungkin tak akan pernah bisa dia temui lagi.)

column1: (But now, she has to be ready to face it.)
column2: (Tapi sekarang, dia harus siap menghadapinya.)

column1: (Asteria hoisted the shoulder strap of the giant weapon case on her back higher up her shoulder, then quickened her pace.)
column2: (Asteria menaikkan tali bahu koper senjata raksasa di punggungnya lebih tinggi, lalu mempercepat langkahnya.)

column1: (Ever since she received this case named "Vindicator's Mark", she had never truly used its power.)
column2: (Sejak menerima koper bernama "Vindicator's Mark" ini, dia tak pernah benar-benar memakai kekuatannya.)

column1: (She even once felt that this care from "afar" was completely superfluous.)
column2: (Dia bahkan pernah merasa perhatian dari "kejauhan" ini sama sekali berlebihan.)

column1: ("Is it your turn to look down on me now, M4?")
column2: ("Sekarang giliranmu meremehkanku, M4?")

column1: (When she received it, she had such a thought.)
column2: (Saat menerimanya, begitulah yang terlintas di benaknya.)

column1: (And she felt that there were more suitable candidates in the AR Team to inherit such a thing than her.)
column2: (Dan dia merasa ada kandidat yang lebih pantas di AR Team untuk mewarisi benda semacam itu daripada dirinya.)

column1: (Whether returning it to M16 or sending it to Soppo—she would definitely be so happy she'd roll around on the spot, and then hug Robella and cry bitterly for a while, right?)
column2: (Entah mengembalikannya ke M16 atau mengirimnya ke Soppo—dia pasti akan girang sampai berguling-guling di tempat, lalu memeluk Robella dan menangis sejadi-jadinya sebentar, kan?)

column1: (In short, whether as a souvenir or as the weapon itself, there are people who need such a thing more than she does.)
column2: (Singkatnya, entah sebagai kenang-kenangan atau sebagai senjatanya sendiri, ada orang yang lebih membutuhkan benda itu daripada dia.)

column1: (So why her?)
column2: (Lalu kenapa dia?)

column1: (She had asked this question countless times to the shooting stars streaking across the night sky.)
column2: (Pertanyaan itu sudah tak terhitung kali dia lontarkan pada bintang jatuh yang melintasi langit malam.)

column1: (But now, Asteria finally understood the meaning of this heavy gift.)
column2: (Tapi sekarang, Asteria akhirnya memahami makna hadiah yang berat ini.)

column1: (It is not some souvenir, nor is it a sharp blade meant to be used for slaughtering in all directions.)
column2: (Ini bukan kenang-kenangan, bukan pula bilah tajam untuk membantai ke segala arah.)

column1: (This is the exclusive connection between them, the anchor point of her having lived in this world...)
column2: (Ini adalah ikatan khusus di antara mereka, titik sauh yang membuktikan dia pernah hidup di dunia ini...)

column1: (And also the proof that the AR Team existed, fought to protect that person, and will continue to move forward in the future.)
column2: (Sekaligus bukti bahwa AR Team pernah ada, pernah bertempur melindungi orang itu, dan akan terus melangkah maju di masa depan.)

column1: Commander, holding on a little longer shouldn't be difficult for you, right?
column2: Komandan, bertahan sebentar lagi seharusnya tidak sulit bagimu, kan?

column1: ...You have to wait for us to come back.
column2: ...Kau harus menunggu kami kembali.
